enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up to chin. Remain still. Turn to right side. Place arm under pillow. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back up. Lie on back. Stretch legs. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket over shoulder. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Turn to right side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and tea using the toaster and kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out bread, butter, and milk. Close fridge. Take out plate, mug, and tea bag. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Fill kettle with water and turn on. Remove toast. Butter toast. Pour water into mug. Add tea bag. Remove tea bag. Add milk. Stir. Pick up toast. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Sip tea. Put plate in sink. Rinse mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and running a load in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open laundry basket. Pick up clothes. Sort into whites and colors. Pick up white pile. Walk to washing machine. Open washing machine door. Put clothes in. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Turn dial to select cycle. Press start button. Walk away.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading course materials and drafting an assignment on the computer at the desk with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Open course materials. Read. Pick up pen. Write notes. Highlight text. Turn page. Open word processor. Type. Move mouse. Click. Scroll. Stretch arms. Continue typing. Save document.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating an early lunch before the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out bread. Take out ham. Take out cheese. Take out plate. Close fridge. Place bread on plate. Add ham. Add cheese. Close bread. Pick up knife. Cut sandwich. Put knife down. Pick up sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Put plate in sink. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Travelling to the hospitality and retail venue for the afternoon shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check phone for timetable. Wait. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Tap card. Walk off bus. Walk to venue.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a part-time hospitality and retail shift, serving customers on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Enter venue. Clock in. Put on apron. Stand at counter. Greet customer. Take order. Press buttons on register. Take payment. Give change. Hand receipt. Prepare coffee. Serve coffee. Clean table. Wipe counter. Restock cups. Greet next customer.

enriched_activities.activity: Travelling home after the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Tap card. Walk off bus. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Remove work clothes. Place in laundry basket. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Put on clean clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables and meat. Close fridge. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat. Put plate in sink and rinse.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying on the computer, writing up assignment notes for the Master of Education
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open assignment document. Read notes. Type. Move mouse. Click. Scroll. Highlight text. Copy. Paste. Read. Type. Save.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone down. Watch. Change channel. Adjust volume. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing things for tomorrow, checking phone messages and tidying the room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Unlock. Check messages. Reply to message. Type. Send. Put phone down. Pick up clothes from floor. Put in laundry basket. Arrange items on desk. Pick up backpack. Pack books. Zip backpack. Set alarm on phone. Plug phone in.

Turn off desk lamp. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Adjust pillow. Turn to side. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to other side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
